name: Soyuz TM-20
about: Soyuz TM-20 (1994-063A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1994 Oct  3. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1994 Nov  3), held fixed
docked to S16609; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q700126), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
landing day from Wikidata; the hour is not given
